archetypes.name: Single Target
archetypes.description: Single target fire, the reliable baseline.

archetypes.name: Splash
archetypes.description: Area damage around the target, the answer to clustered waves.

archetypes.name: Frost
archetypes.description: Trades damage for control: every hit chills its target.

archetypes.name: Poison
archetypes.description: Little damage up front, punishing over a long wave. Poison ignores armor.

archetypes.name: Chain Lightning
archetypes.description: Strikes a target then jumps to nearby creeps with weaker arcs.

archetypes.name: Support
archetypes.description: Fires nothing of its own; sharpens every tower standing near it.
